colourNotes: The interior of the HighLine garden shed is always grey white and the roof surface is always metallic quartz grey (Colours & Sizes tab).
Last two SKU digits: x0 = standard door, x9 = double door (from EAN/SKU pairs in the data sheet). Size digit: 1=HS, 2=H1, 3=H2, 4=H3, 5=H4, 6=H5, 7=H6.
sellingPoints: Flat Roof Aesthetics for Your Storage Space
Modern flat roof with acrylic glass panel for optimal light incidence
Double the sheet steel thickness compared to low-cost providers
Maintenance-free for life - 20-year guarantee subject to Biohort's warranty terms and conditions.

Functionality: 360° acrylic glass panels provide sufficient light inside from all sides
Integrated gutter with a connection for a 1 1/4" hose
Gutter with integrated leaf traps on both sides
Comfortable door opening with gas spring
Security: 3-way locking mechanism complete with stainless steel door handle
Robust roof construction for a snow load of up to 150 kg/m²
Storm-proof up to wind force 12 (according to the Beaufort Scale: hurricane)* (* with professional assembly and anchoring)
Quality at its best: Top quality materials: galvanised, polyamide enamel coated steel plate, screws and hinges made of stainless steel
20-year guarantee subject to Biohort's warranty terms and conditions.

standardEquipment: Stainless steel door handle, complete with standard cylinder; 3-way locking mechanism; with spare key
Gas spring: assists opening and closing, holds the door open or closed
Gutters with integrated leaf traps, with hose connection
Acrylic glass skylight: 360° acrylic glass panels
Shelves / support rails: two shelves (length 24.5 cm, width 72 cm) and two support rails; galvanised steel plate; max. load 15 kg per shelf
Tool holder on the inside of the door panel: 2 pcs. (max. five per door panel)
guarantee: 20-year guarantee subject to Biohort's warranty terms and conditions. FAQ: covers corrosion of metal parts and defective or unusable parts; statutory 24-month warranty only for wear, moving parts, colour changes, electrical, plastic and rubber parts.
delivery: Free Shipping within 3 weeks (product page and every variant's delivery_message). FAQ: free kerbside delivery; Great Britain listed among free-kerbside countries (mainland, road passable for a 38-tonne lorry).
packaging: Packed in seven to eleven boxes, photo-illustrated assembly manual included
steelThickness: No figure published. Page says "Double the sheet steel thickness compared to low-cost providers"; comparison table: "Galvanised with protective zinc layer of at least 150 g/m² and polyamide enamel coating (same for all garden sheds)".
roof: Modern flat roof with 360° acrylic glass skylight panels; roof surface always metallic quartz grey. Snow load 150 kg/m². Wind load 150 km/h | wind force 12 (with professional assembly and anchoring).

doors.source: https://www.biohort.com/gb-en/p/garden-shed-highline?country_id=gb (Colours & Sizes "Double doors: 155 x 182 cm"; comparison table "DD: 155 x 182 cm")

doorPlacement: Tip (Colours & Sizes): You can rotate the HighLine from size H2 onwards and the standard door can be installed in any side wall. From size H4 onwards, you can also install the double doors in the side wall (off-centre). No double door for HS (no data-sheet row, no offer).
sideCanopy: Optional side/front roof can attach from size H2 on the gutter side (one or both sides). Sizes S (150 cm wide) and L (282 cm wide) per the side canopy description; roof surface always metallic quartz grey; only a concrete or point foundation is suitable for the canopy supports.
groundAnchorsOnGravel: For size HS, H: 8 pcs. in total; for size H2, H3: 10 pcs. in total; for size H4, H5, H6: 12 pcs. in total (data sheet note, as printed - "H" presumably H1).
bicycleCapacityFAQ: HighLine/Panorama (max. rim 29"): H1 3-4, H2 4-5, H3 5-6, H4 6-7, H5 7-8 bicycles (FAQ table; H6 not listed).
